text: ...and there we saw there was a-a man on the ground and they (inaudible) bleeding from the back of his head, and by that time I was trying to call 9-1-1,and they were(sigh)transferring me or something. I was like, “Don’t transfer me!  Don’t transfer me!”  and yes I did.
